messages:
rene: I opened a small PR to add a "fallback playbook" subsection to the Dedicated provisioning guide. It's mainly examples + a tiny ops checklist. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4448

maria: can you paste the YAML example here? easier to comment quickly.

rene: pasted:

```yaml
fallback_playbook:
  trigger: p99_latency_ms > 200
  steps:
    - verify: compatibility_check returns true
    - action: route_to fallback-pool-eu
    - action: downgrade_model_variant: redwood/gpt-medium-quant
    - action: set_rate_limit: 15rps
    - verify: smoke_test_function_calls
```

sam: please change threshold to `threshold_ms: 200` for clarity and add a telemetry label sample.

jin: also add a short note that downgrade may cause KV cache cold start and recommend warmup window.

rene: good points. I'll update to threshold_ms and add `telemetry.labels: ["routing.fallback:eu-playbook", "model.variant:gpt-medium-quant"]` in the checklist.

ops-bot: link-check: docs/dedicated/provisioning.md line 72: internal link to /handbook/legal/sla.pdf returns 404.

maria: FYI legal SLA PDF lives in private repo; we should link to sales playbook instead for public docs.

rene: switching link to /handbook/sales/enterprise-sla-summary. Will push change and a one-line prose explanation of what customers can expect during fallback (latency uplift, possible feature limits).

sam: also add an example curl command for the smoke test so SREs can run it easily. Tiny snippet is fine.

jin: wording nit: avoid "downgrade" in user-facing text? maybe use "switch to reduced-capability variant". But ok if PR keeps it short.

rene: I'll use "reduced-capability variant" in prose, YAML keeps shorthand. Pushing now. Thanks all.
